name: Backstab
description: Strike from the shadows for massive damage. Requires the enemy to be unaware.
flavor_text: Honour is for those who can afford to lose.

name: Shadow Step
description: Teleport behind an enemy in an instant, repositioning and gaining initiative.

name: Poison Blade
description: Coat your weapon in venom. Attacks deal damage over 3 turns.
flavor_text: The wound you don't notice is the one that kills you.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Deploy a smoke bomb that blinds enemies and grants you stealth for 2 turns.

name: Assassinate
description: A single lethal strike that deals massive damage, tripled against unaware enemies.
flavor_text: One chance. One moment. One life ends.

name: Evasion
description: Passively gives a chance to dodge physical attacks entirely, based on agility.
flavor_text: The best defense is not being there.
